entries.definition:
premium
     n 1: payment for insurance [syn: {insurance premium}]
     2: a fee charged for exchanging currencies [syn: {agio}, {agiotage},
         {exchange premium}]
     3: payment or reward (especially from a government) for acts
        such as catching criminals or killing predatory animals or
        enlisting in the military [syn: {bounty}]

premium
     adj : having or reflecting superior quality or value; "premium
           gasoline at a premium price"

a.
1 superior in quality; higher in price or value.
2 (lb en automotive) High-end; belonging to the market segment between mid-market and luxury.
alt.
(alter de Premium)
n.
1 A prize or award.
2 Something offered at a reduced price as an inducement to buy something else.
3 A bonus paid in addition to normal payments.
a.
(lb de advertising often in compounds) #English
alt.
(alt es prémium)
n.
1 (l en premium):
2 # a prize, a reward
3 # a (l en premium): money paid for e.g. an insurance
4 something (l en premium) (superior in quality; higher in price or value)
5 (lb id colloquial) (w lang=en Pertamina)'s petrol or gasoline product with octane rating of 88.(rfv-sense: id)
6 (lb id in extension) petrol, gasoline(rfv-sense: id)
a.
(l en premium)

subscriber
     n 1: someone who expresses strong approval [syn: {endorser}, {indorser},
           {ratifier}]
     2: someone who contracts to receive and pay for a certain
        number of issues of a publication [syn: {reader}]
     3: someone who contributes (or promises to contribute) a sum of
        money [syn: {contributor}]

n.
1 A person who subscribes to a publication or a service.
2 (lb en programming) A system or component that subscribes to something, such as an event, made available by a publisher.
vb.
to subscribe
